info.title: QuorumKV M10 logged GET subset
info.description: PUT/DELETE and POST logged GET. Every GET persists a fresh current-term read entry, commits through a durable quorum and captures its result at exact M02 application, then revalidates leadership. No local read, lease, ReadIndex, CAS HTTP, session, deduplication or automatic retry. Existing M08 limits/errors retained.

200.description: Committed current-term quorum, applied result and valid completion fence. Independent attempt; no deduplication.

409.description: Applied deterministic resource rejection; no mutation.
